verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions data residency, region selection, or storage location controls for Mintlify; only self-hosting on customer-controlled cloud/on-prem infra is documented, which addresses hosting location but not a chooseable region/residency setting within the SaaS product itself. missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection controls, compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/SOC2 data location commitments), any statement on where SaaS-hosted data is stored.
